post_install: /opt/homebrew/bin/fish -l -c 'test -n "$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD"; and opencode service set hostname 0.0.0.0; and opencode service set port 40960; and opencode service set password "$OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD"' || echo 'opencode service config NOT set (is OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD in secrets.fish?)'; launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/xyz.stjhn.opencode2 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/xyz.stjhn.opencode 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/xyz.stjhn.opencode.plist && echo loaded xyz.stjhn.opencode
